svg.title: Each Lx is multilinear and symmetric. Symmetry follows by permuting the momentum variables and the labels together, using physical symmetry of x and invariance of the product photon measure. The diagonal identity for real lists therefore polarizes to arbitrary real lists. For example, expand the diagonal polynomial at h+tu; its derivative replaces one slot by u, and symmetry identifies the sum with n times that term. Induction on n recovers all mixed terms. Compact tests supported spacelike to the trace support form a complex vector space, and every such list is a complex linear combination of real lists by its real and imaginary parts, with the same support restrictions. Complex multilinearity then gives the polarized identity for all these lists, with complex conjugation of the lists on the conjugated side.
